payload.accepted_scope: Illustrative point-core whole-station nominal at 3.15 GW, 6.3 MPa, 157 rad/s; declared time-zero equilibrium and uninterrupted 3600 s with six automatic loops

constraints: pressurizer/secondary boron and isolated reserves fixed
inactive spray/dump and zero surge branch

limitations: Only NPP-11.01 is closed; NPP-11.02/03/04, NPP-04.04 and NPP-14.03/04 remain open.
Initial energy differs by an explicitly declared time-zero amount; no live operating-state projection.
Point-core topology and inactive spray/dump equilibrium branch only; no spatial-core or experimental plant validation.
Installed coarse files are declared reference inputs; installed fine and native full coarse replay are independently executed.
Whole R1/R2/R3 acceptance and superiority to other simulators are not claimed.

protocol.initial_setup: Constrained fresh time-zero solve, same equipment parameters and conserved masses; explicit initial energy declaration
protocol.native_scope: Full prefix re-executed and full suffix compared in installed delivery

study_report.accepted_scope: Prospective coarse/fine full-hour stationarity; native qualification is separate delivery evidence

full_hour_envelope.scope: Whole physical-vector span, not only measured setpoint error; normalization max(abs(end),1 SI unit)

inventory.forecast_scope: Conditional constant-rate extrapolation to mass/pressure bounds only; temperature, phase or suction limits may occur earlier; not a guaranteed operating horizon
inventory.integration_scope: Sampled trapezoidal quadrature; residual includes sampling error and is not a solver balance error
